text.content:
Sect: None (extremely rare in all sects; a handful have found their way into the Anarch Movement)

A dhampir is something that, by all Kindred lore, should not exist: the half-mortal offspring of a vampire and a mortal. Gypsy folklore coined the term, and it is only now becoming known among scholarly Kindred. A fifteenth-generation vampire of either gender can, very rarely, conceive a half-mortal child who develops and is born in the normal fashion. Because thin-blooded vampires are themselves a recent phenomenon of the Final Nights, dhampirs are younger still — by their nature, no dhampir is older than about twenty. Most spend their lives among ordinary mortals, unaware of their heritage until the truth arrives as a shattering revelation. Most vampires have never heard of dhampirs and dismiss the idea as absurd, but the handful the Anarch Movement has encountered are regarded as an ultimate wild card: something that isn't supposed to exist, and is welcomed (or exploited) precisely because it does. Some anarchs see dhampirs as living proof that the Final Nights have truly arrived.

Disciplines

Like ghouls, dhampirs begin play with Prowess, the first Basic Potence power. They have no clan Disciplines, but may take one additional Basic power from Animalism, Auspex, Celerity, Dominate, Fortitude, Obfuscate, Potence or Presence. Dhampirs always pay out-of-clan Discipline costs, and can never raise any Discipline above the Basic level, even if a dhampir later becomes a ghoul.

Virtues, Willpower and Blood

All dhampirs, without exception, follow the Path of Humanity and assign Virtue Traits as any mortal character would; a dhampir embracing one of the Paths of Enlightenment is theoretically possible but would require prolonged exposure to people and events that would almost certainly get her killed. Dhampirs start with two Willpower Traits. They generate their own (weak) vitae and have ten Blood Traits, regenerating one per day; a dhampir can also drink vampiric vitae to recover Blood Traits faster, but every Trait of vampire vitae ingested moves her one-third of the way toward a full blood bond, without granting any of the powers a ghoul would gain from the same blood. Dhampirs receive eight Freebie Traits at creation, plus any further Free Traits earned from Flaws or Negative Traits. They use Blood Traits to raise Physical Attributes and may spend a Willpower Trait to refresh an Attribute category, exactly as ghouls do.

Merits and Flaws

Dhampirs have access to the full range of Merits and Flaws, except those that only make sense for true vampires (a dhampir cannot take Fangless, for instance, since dhampirs have no fangs to lose). They also have access to two exclusive options: Perceive Vampires and Fragile Bones (see the Merits & Flaws compendium).
